# Orion RCA
> Evidence-first AI agent for production root-cause analysis. Python, Apache-2.0. Runs offline with a deterministic reference policy, or with an LLM.

- [README](README.md): what it does, evals, quickstart
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Harness](docs/harness.md): tool gate, ledger, verifier, critic
- [Evals](docs/evals.md): scenarios, metrics, gate
- [MCP](README.md#for-your-agents): `orion mcp`
